content: If an SdServiceGr oup is stopped by Sd_ServiceGroupStop(), the AUTOSAR Service Discovery module shall set all SdClientServiceS, which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_RELEASED where the corresponding client request counter (see SWS_SD_00747 ) has reached 0, and all SdServerServices which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_SERVER_SERVICE_DOWN where the corresponding server availability counter (see SWS_SD_00747 ) has reached 0.
